Name: Making certain informational requirements for notices concerning rent increase exemption programs discretionary.
Title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to making certain informational requirements for notices concerning rent increase exemption programs discretionary

History.Description: This Introduction was Introduced by Council
This Introduction was Referred to Comm by Council to the Committee on Finance

Summary: This bill would allow the Commissioner of Finance to exercise discretion over certain informational requirements set forth in section 11-138 of the Administrative Code concerning the Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption and Disability Rent Increase Exemption programs.
Text:
Be it enacted by the Council as follows:


Section 1.  Subdivision c of section 11-138 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as added by local law number 13 for the year 2016, is amended by adding a new paragraph 3 to read as follows:
3. Notwithstanding paragraph 1 of this subdivision, the commissioner of finance may, in their discretion, omit information otherwise required to be included in a notice pursuant to such paragraph where including such information would not promote the goals of the senior citizen rent increase exemption or disability rent increase exemption program.
§ 2. This local law takes effect immediately.
